description: JSON to Markdown. Any JSON document in, URL-encoded as the json query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), a clean Markdown rendering out: object keys as headed sections, uniform object arrays as tables, scalar arrays as bullet lists. Price: $0.02 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

json.description: The JSON document to render, as text (up to 12,000 bytes).

name: json-to-md
